title: Enforceable promise and sources of contract law
shortTitle: Enforceable promise and sources of contract law
summary: Contract law supplies remedies for some promises and recognizes some promised duties.
notes: Restatement § 1 supplies the introductory definition. A promise and an enforceable contract are separate steps in analysis. Common-law decisions, statutes, and persuasive restatements have different authority. Article 2 governs the sales setting within its scope, with ordinary law supplementing it unless displaced. The text begins with why enforcement occurs and what breach remedies do before turning to formation. The authors do not treat one philosophical account as the entire law.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 1–10. Open assigned page 1.
